golden_corpus.note: Golden sources are pinned by LF-normalized SHA-256 in their own manifest; this registry does not duplicate those pins.

notes: T0/T1 run offline and deterministically from these pinned fixtures; no network, clock, or randomness.
SHA-256 pins are LF-normalized UTF-8 bytes for cross-platform determinism; contract fixtures are enforced LF via .gitattributes.
